title: Wiola 13M：用于参数高效小型语言模型的门控螺旋注意力架构
summary: Wiola是一种仅解码器的小型语言模型，通过三个即插即用组件提升性能：螺旋旋转位置编码、门控螺旋注意力和蝶形前馈块。该架构在保持参数量的同时改善长距离建模和梯度流，并证明训练与推理等价，提供开源实现。
summary_en: Wiola is a decoder-only small language model with three drop-in components: Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding, Gated Spiral Attention, and Butterfly feed-forward block. It improves long-range modeling and gradient flow while maintaining parameter count, and proves exact equivalence between training and inference, with open-source release.
